name: bayesian_update_v1
mechanism: On NIFTY, when three independent evidence streams — a 1-minute directional price push (ret_12 z-score), above-average volume confirming institutional participation (volume/avg_volume ratio), and VWAP positioning reflecting benchmark-driven flow — simultaneously point the same direction, a Bayesian running posterior accumulates per 5-second bar. When the posterior exceeds 0.68, the probability that the three-way alignment is coincidental falls below 32%, indicating that FII algorithmic buyers, domestic VWAP-benchmarked orders, and momentum algos are all aligned. NIFTY then sustains direction for another 60-90 seconds because the order flow driving each evidence stream is only partially filled and continues reinforcing the move. The posterior's 3-bar monotonic increase confirms that evidence is accumulating (new order flow arriving) rather than peaking (existing flow finishing), distinguishing a continuation from a reversal.
core_signal_oneliner: Naive Bayes posterior combining 1-minute return z-score, volume ratio, and VWAP position exceeds 0.68 with 3-bar monotonic increase
